A l arge number of smaller -sized θ´ and S′ precipitated in composites can restrict and impede the dislocation movement, which is favorable for simultaneous improvement in strength and fracture strain.

In comparison with 2009Al alloy, the tensile strength s of the samples for 9 vol. % nano-sized TiC x/2009Al composites increase 38.6%, 18.4% and 26.6%, while the fracture strain s increase 5.2%, 31.8% and 73.7% , respectively.
